notes.title: Nebulatic Update #3: CVD Friendly Sprites & Contrast/Flashing Options
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37597434/28d79854c0caa6f35fc1f97bd55b2d077ce100c5.jpg[/img]
[h3]
This is a very minor update but will impact you most if:[/h3]

[list]
[*][h3]You and/or your friends have some form of color vision deficiency.[/h3] The sprites which differentiate you from your friends when playing local co-op (or via Steam's Remote Play) are no longer just differentiated by color. Each player has a unique sprite, which should make identification easier for folks with some kind of CVD. Hope this helps those of you who like to play with friends!

[*][h3]You are sensitive to contrast and/or flashes.[/h3] There are now options in the Calibrate menu to freely adjust the in-game contrast and presence of "hit flashes" (color changes that occur when an object is hit) to your liking. This should make the game easier to play for those of you who either want or need the game's contrast to be reduced/increased and flashing to be enabled/disabled.
[/list]

Always trying my best to make the experience comfortable for everyone, so if you want to see any accessibility changes, don't hesitate to ask! Everyone deserves to enjoy the same things. <3

Remember to shower and care for yourself,
-Nick

notes.title: Nebulatic Update #2: Color Vision Deficiency Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37597434/aa90a59b552627268faa6c0fbfa2ad650fb76a91.jpg[/img]

[h3]
This is a very minor update but will impact you most if:[/h3]

[list]
[*][h3]You have some form of color vision deficiency.[/h3] There are now options in the Calibrate menu to freely adjust the in-game colors to your liking. Sorry this took so long everyone! I'm not color vision deficient myself and I really wanted to make sure I could make something flexible enough for all players. Everyone's vision is different and, ultimately, you'll know what works best for you more than I will. Even still, I'm not sure this will make everyone happy, but it's a start (I'm only human!).
[/list]

This isn't the end of CVD support: a future update will also include differences for vessel designs so players can distinguish themselves more easily when playing with friends.

Don't hesitate to reach out if you'd like me to tweak something for you. It's my goal to make this game as accessible as possible. <3

Tell someone today you love them,
-Nick

notes.title: Nebulatic Update #1: Photosensitivity and Achievements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37597434/c327f7e2931f93d2822c8fa61177815d417e0f98.jpg[/img]

[h3]
This is a very minor update but will impact you most if:[/h3]

[list]
[*][h3]You have photosensitivity.[/h3] There is now a warning at the start of the game that should have been there long ago. Additionally, transcending isn't quite as bright as it was in the past. You can tweak the "glow" of the game in the Calibrate Menu if this still isn't comfortable for you. <3

[*] [h3]You are looking to 100% the achievements.[/h3] You can now obtain the "[i]Understanding[/i]" achievement, which was not possible in the past. If you are missing this one, you can now play through [i]Sadness[/i] to obtain it!
[/list]

Don't hesitate to reach out if you'd like me to tweak something for you. It's my goal to make this game as accessible as possible. <3

Tell someone today you love them,
-Nick

notes.title: LIVE with the Dev on World Mental Health Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37597434/230cb6394f274648696dc0e8e35fd9e784d30152.jpg[/img]

[h2]We're all human beings. [/h2]
And you know what? 2020's been a doo-doo year in a lot of ways.
In honor of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Mental_Health_Day][b]World Mental Health Day[/b][/url], let's have a live stream where I'll play Nebula within, we can all hang out, relax, and be good to ourselves.

[h2]Join here or [url=https://www.twitch.tv/strafestudios] on Twitch[/url] on Saturday October 10th[/h2]

I'm not a mental health professional by any means - I'm just a dude who made a game and cares. Hop in and we can talk about anything, be it this game or anything else on your heart/mind.

Even if you don't stop by, try to take some time out of your Saturday to care for yourself. That can be hard to do most of the time, so don't feel like there's any one "right" way. Just know that there are other people out here who are all floating on their own tiny little boats in this big ocean around you too.

[h3]You are not alone. <3[/h3]

notes.title: The gates to the Nebula Within have opened...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37597434/50dda2e613a9876a1f0f5e3b21421eb70cd24ebd.jpg[/img]

Experience the colorful & contemplative twin-stick shooter of your consciousness before it comes out: [b][u]the[i][u] totally free demo[/u][/i] for Nebula Within is available now![/u][/b] Give it a try, explore your emotions, and search for self-acceptance in the indie passion project that got me through 2019.

[h3][b]Featured in this demo:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Swift, smooth, and responsive twin-stick shooter gameplay.
[*] Confront the geometric abstractions of your feelings in completely different encounters every run.
[*] Cooperate [b][u]locally with up to 8 friends.[/u][/b]
[*] [i]Explore[/i] increasingly difficult waves of challenges.
[*] Rewrite negative thoughts into positive mantras. 
[*] Acquire reassuring allies to actively assist along the way. 
[*] Create chains of allies to help you progress through your emotions. 
[*] Face a variety of mini-bosses as you overcome challenges. 
[*] Find five different types of affirmations to empower you.
[*] Reveal meaningful epigraphs, footnotes, and more in [b]Part 1[/b] of your [i]Nebulatic Diary. [/i]
[/list]

[h3]From me, to you:[/h3]
You know this began as a personal project but has grown organically over time. Likewise, I hope you find tranquility, peace, excitement, purpose, or the motivation to continue persevering by playing this game. Maybe you don't, but I really hope that you do.

[b]It isn't perfect, but then again, nothing ever is. It can get a little tough at times, but so can life.[/b]

[h3][i]Hang in there.
You're not alone.[/i]
[/h3]
Love,
Nick Oueijan
